status_notes: Zuccarello will not play because of a lingering injury that initially kept the forward out for three games from Oct. 10-17. … Byfield could return after missing the past two games because of an upper-body injury. If he can't, it's possible Ceci, a defenseman, gets into the lineup and the Kings go with 11 forwards and seven defensemen. … Reimer will make his first start with the Rangers. The 38-year-old signed a one-year, $850,000 contract on Sunday after playing one game with Hartford of the American Hockey League on a professional tryout contract. He made 35 saves in a 2-0 win against Providence on Friday. … Dorofeyev was moved to the third line late in the Rangers' 7-4 loss at the Ottawa Senators on Saturday. He had been a regular in New York's top-six forward group since the start of the season. Bjorkstrand will start the game in the top-six instead.

status_notes: The Red Wings held an optional morning skate, and likely will use 12 forwards and six defensemen, after going with 11 forwards and seven defensemen in a 4-1 loss at the Calgary Flames on Saturday. Mazur will come in for Englund, a defenseman. ... Postava is expected to make his first NHL start. It would be his second career game; he replaced Gibson in the third period of a 5-2 win against the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday. ... Frederic and Howard will play after being scratched from a 7-2 win against the Toronto Maple Leafs on Saturday, replacing forwards Hallander and Jones. ... Ekholm is expected to return in time for a three-game road trip that begins at the New York Islanders on Saturday. The defenseman will miss his second straight game Monday and is unlikely to play against the Flames on Wednesday.
